atoms.sound: Hey Reece! Do you like living in a city? I know some people think it’s too busy.
Hey Dennis! Yeah, I do like it. It can be noisy sometimes, but there’s always something to do. I like that everything is close: school, the park, and the cafe near the library.
Oh, I know that one! Is it the cafe with the green chairs outside?
Yes, that’s the one. I go there a lot after school. They have really good muffins, and the music is nice too. It’s my favourite place. What about you? Do you have a favourite place in the city?
Hmm, I think my favourite place is the park. I go there almost every weekend to relax. Sometimes I take a book or just listen to music under the trees.
That sounds nice. I go to the park sometimes too, but I usually read at the library. I can’t focus in the park because it is too loud — Do you ever go to the cinema?
Yes, I do. I love watching films on the big screen, especially at the weekend. The last film I saw was very funny.

atoms.a: What is Denys’ favourite place in the city?
atoms.sound: What is Dennis’s favourite place in the city?
b: Denys’ favourite place is the library.

Rhys’ favourite place is the cafe with the red chairs.

atoms.a: Why does Rhys like living in the city?
atoms.sound: Why does Reece like living in the city?
b: He likes that it is crowded.

atoms.a: Where does Rhys go to read?
atoms.sound: Where does Reece go to read?
Is there any place in the city you don’t like?
Hmm, probably the train station. It’s always crowded, and sometimes the trains are late. I only go there when the place I want to go to is too far to walk or go by bike. What about you?
I don’t really like the hospital. It feels cold and sad, even though the doctors and nurses are very kind.
I feel the same. I only go there when someone in my family is ill. What about restaurants? Do you like eating out?
Not really. I prefer home-cooked meals, especially when my dad cooks. His food is the best.
Oh, I’m the opposite! I love going to restaurants. I like trying new food and eating with friends. I like the little Italian restaurant near the library. The pizza there is really good.

atoms.a: Which place does Denys not like?
atoms.sound: Which place does Dennis not like?

atoms.a: Where is the Italian restaurant that Denys mentions?
atoms.sound: Where is the Italian restaurant that Dennis mentions?
b: The restaurant is near the supermarket.
The restaurant is near his home.

atoms.a: Which place do Rhys and Denys both not like?
atoms.sound: Which place do Reece and Dennis both not like?
b: Neither of them like the restaurant.
Neither of them like the cinema.
